inclusionQuotes.text: We set out 26 years ago to transform computer graphics. inclusionQuotes.text: Our invention of the GPU in 1999 made real-time programmable shading possible, giving artists an infinite palette for expression. In 2018, the introduction of the Turing architecture and NVIDIA RTX ™ ray-tracing technology fulfilled another vision of computer scientists, paving the way to new levels of art and realism in real-time graphics. We’ve led the field of visual computing for decades.
inclusionQuotes.heading: NVIDIA REINVENTS MODERN COMPUTER GRAPHICS

inclusionQuotes.text: In 2012, GPU-accelerated AlexNet ushered in the era of superhuman image recognition. inclusionQuotes.heading: TWO GIANT WAVES OF AI

inclusionQuotes.text: AI is spilling out of the cloud and into the edge where oceans of raw data are generated by the world’s largest industries. On factory floors. In stores. On city streets. In urgent care facilities. The NVIDIA EGX platform puts AI performance closer to the data to drive real-time decisions when and where they’re needed most.
inclusionQuotes.heading: POWERING AI AT THE EDGE

inclusionQuotes.text: AI breakthroughs no longer come from scientific labs and hyperscale cloud providers alone. inclusionQuotes.heading: EVERYTHING THAT MOVES WILL BE AUTONOMOUS
